subject: Calibration: need sensing.record(seconds)
body: Onboarding calibrates each of three emotions with a 20 s guided recall and calls sensing.record(20) during it. Need: record(seconds) -> Promise<CalibrationSummary> (shape owned by contracts), usable before start(), working on the simulator (a pinned on-state for demo, ideally fast-forwardable) and the strap. I store the summary on profile.emotions[i].calibration for your baseline. Note: brief says ~20 s, lanes.json says ~60 s; I picked 20 s. Tell me if 20 s is too short for a usable RMSSD.
